subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should production retain the existing OAuth App through an ownership transfer, or replace it with a new officially owned app and coordinated credential cutover?
rationale: Both paths require privileged GitHub App ownership and production secret access, and the safe cutover depends on operator access and continuity requirements not represented in source.

options.title: Transfer existing app
options.body: Transfer the current app to official ownership, update its metadata, rotate its secret, and verify all existing callbacks with minimal client-ID disruption.

options.title: Replace and cut over
options.body: Create a new official app, update production credentials, validate web and CLI authorization, and then retire the personal app.

recommendation.title: Transfer existing app
recommendation.body: Transfer the current app to official ownership, update its metadata, rotate its secret, and verify all existing callbacks with minimal client-ID disruption.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was assigned the predecessor issue and is the best available coordinator for the privileged production follow-up.
